ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Mercury

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on relationships and partnerships. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Venus retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on routine, daily work and health. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
With Venus retrograde in your home and family sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on home and family. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
With Venus retrograde in your money sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your money and what you value. A new beginning may be born from here.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your image and your personal energy. This is where your strength lies today.
With Venus retrograde in your inner life sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on rest and your inner life. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Venus retrograde in your career sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your career and your goals. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:7}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. It is a good day to start something in this area.
With Venus retrograde in your intimacy sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.
